messages.subject: Question about build a "data.stack"
parts:
Hi every all

I have one question related with build a "data.stack."
¿The data of  latitude and longitude necessarily they have to be in positive?
My data is from Chile, normally for example in lon (-71.30) and lat (-28.46) but when I build  the "data.stack"  R stop workins and abort session.
But, when passing the latitude to positive values is constructed the "data.stack".

I hope you can help me.
Regards!

Can you provide some more information about your model and code?
Are you using inla.stack in combination with an spde model on a mesh?
Have you read the "read this first" spde tutorial on r-inla.org? It explains the basics of inla.stack().

Finn
